provenance: The 36 questions and their gold phrases were written by the AI assistant that built this evaluation after checking, in the PDF text read by pdfplumber, that each gold phrase occurs in its paper (comparison ignores case, spaces and punctuation because that reader drops spaces in some PDFs). A passage counts as a hit when its quotation contains the gold phrase. NOT reviewed by a human; some gold phrases are generic words, so a hit shows the right region was found, not that the question was answered. Papers: DPO, Mixtral and Chain-of-Thought (benchmark/) and Constitutional AI, GQA and Mistral 7B (heldout/), all CC BY 4.0 as recorded in their manifests.
